architecture_decisions.title: Consolidated AI Service into Main Backend
architecture_decisions.decision: Integrate AI service into main backend (port 7000) instead of separate service (port 7001)
architecture_decisions.context: Initially had separate AI service for modularity, but operational complexity outweighed benefits
rationale: Simplified deployment: 2 services instead of 3
Reduced latency: No proxy overhead between services
Easier debugging: Single process to monitor
Lower resource usage: One Python process instead of two
Shared database connections: More efficient resource utilization

alternatives_considered.option: Keep separate AI service on port 7001
alternatives_considered.rejected_reason: Operational complexity not justified for current scale
Team size and scale don't warrant microservices

impact.deployment: Simplified: Only need to manage 2 services

architecture_decisions.title: SQLite + FAISS over PostgreSQL + pgvector
architecture_decisions.decision: Use SQLite with FAISS for vector search instead of PostgreSQL with pgvector
architecture_decisions.context: Need vector similarity search for AI RAG system
rationale: Simpler deployment: No PostgreSQL server setup required
Sufficient performance: FAISS excellent for current data volume (~6,500 chunks)
Single file backups: Easy backup and restore
Lower operational overhead: No database server to maintain
Faster development: No complex database setup

alternatives_considered.rejected_reason: Current scale doesn't require PostgreSQL capabilities
Prefer self-hosted solution for control and cost

impact.scalability: Adequate for 10,000+ chunks, may need migration beyond 100,000

architecture_decisions.migration_path: PostgreSQL + pgvector if needed at scale

architecture_decisions.title: Jasown Script Auto-Approval with Weighted Ratings
architecture_decisions.decision: Automatically approve Jasown scripts with 5x weighted ratings
architecture_decisions.context: Jasown is the authoritative script creator for UO Outlands community
rationale: Community trust: Jasown scripts are gold standard
Reduced admin workload: No need to review Jasown submissions
Quality indication: 5x weight reflects higher quality/trust
User expectation: Community expects Jasown scripts to be featured

implementation.detection: Case-insensitive check for 'jasown' or 'jasown scripts' in author field

alternatives_considered.option: Treat Jasown scripts like any other
alternatives_considered.rejected_reason: Doesn't reflect community standards and trust
Weighting system more flexible and fair

architecture_decisions.title: Maximum 3 Tags Per Script
architecture_decisions.decision: Enforce maximum of 3 tags per script
architecture_decisions.context: Tag system for script categorization and search
rationale: Forces meaningful categorization: Users must choose most relevant tags
Better search UX: Avoids tag spam and over-categorization
UI constraints: Limited space for tag display in cards
Search relevance: Fewer tags = more precise matching

alternatives_considered.rejected_reason: Leads to tag spam and poor categorization
Still too many, doesn't force prioritization

architecture_decisions.may_revisit: If users consistently request more tags

architecture_decisions.title: AI Confidence Threshold System
architecture_decisions.decision: Four-tier confidence system with admin review for low confidence
architecture_decisions.context: AI should never make assumptions when uncertain about user intent
rationale: Safety: Prevents AI from generating incorrect code when unsure
Quality: Human oversight ensures high-quality responses
Learning: Admin corrections improve AI over time
User trust: Better to ask than give wrong answer

architecture_decisions.title: Discord OAuth with GG Membership Verification
architecture_decisions.decision: Require Discord authentication AND GG Discord server membership
architecture_decisions.context: Platform is for GG community only
rationale: Community-first: Only GG members can contribute
User identity: Discord ID provides stable user identification
Trust model: Discord membership validates community belonging
Reduced spam: Limits access to verified community members

implementation.verification: Check guild membership via Discord API
implementation.retry_logic: Exponential backoff for rate limit handling

alternatives_considered.rejected_reason: Not aligned with GG community-first goal

architecture_decisions.title: No Type Hints in Python Code
architecture_decisions.decision: Keep Python code without type hints
rationale: Cleaner code: Less visual clutter
Team preference: Developers prefer Python without types
Pydantic provides validation: Type safety at boundaries
Faster development: Less boilerplate to write

mitigation.validation: Pydantic models at all API boundaries

architecture_decisions.title: Task Template for Feature Development
architecture_decisions.decision: Require task template for all new features to manage complexity
architecture_decisions.context: Codebase growing, need structured approach to features
rationale: Consistency: All features follow same planning process
Documentation: Built-in documentation from start
Approval: Strategic checkpoint before implementation
Memory: Easy to reference past decisions
architecture_decisions.usage: Required for new features, optional for bug fixes
